page.overview:
Who is Cavill?

Cavill, called the "White Wolf", is a Loremaster of Hoeth and a trusted companion of Prince Eltharion of the kingdom of Yvresse on Ulthuan. He is invariably a skilled warrior-mage who excels at battling large, monstrous opponents.

Cavill as a character is a reference to [https://www.pcgamesn.com/total-war-warhammer-2/henry-cavill-loremaster Henry Cavill], a British actor who is a great fan of the Total War: Warhammer series of PC games and Warhammer and Warhammer 40,000 in general.

Cavill's unique "White Wolf" trait is a reference to [https://witcher.fandom.com/wiki/Geralt_of_Rivia Geralt of Rivia], the titular character of The Witcher novel series, who is a professional monster hunter who uses magic and potions to hunt down creatures that threatemn the Humans of his world. Henry Cavill also played Geralt in the The Witcher show on the Netflix streaming service for three seasons. The trait's flavour text, "Wind's Howling," refers to a popular quote from Geralt, who would occasionally say it in the third game of the PC game adaptation of the novels, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt.

Additionally, Cavill's name could also allude to the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DC_Extended_Universe DC Extended Universe]. Henry Cavill played Superman in "Man of Steel" and other films in the DCEU and Eltharion is considered by many gamers to be the "Batman of the High Elves" due to his similar, melancholic personality and his role as almost a vigilante in the service of Ulthuan.
